title: Ajisai HostProtocolV2
description: The host wire format rendered directly from the Semantic Spine. It reflects the six canonical value domains and the outward-observable stack, and carries no legacy concept (module catalog, tensor shape, logical-unknown axis, absence origin/recoverability, capability set). It is the only current protocol: the superseded V1 surface has been removed, and the version field remains so a future breaking change stays identifiable.

protocol.description: Protocol identifier carried by every V2 document.

stack.description: Observed stack values, bottom to top.

presentation.description: Presentation-only display intent; never changes execution semantics.

value.description: One of the six canonical value domains, discriminated by `type`.

numerator.description: scalar: rational numerator (arbitrary precision, decimal string).

denominator.description: scalar: rational denominator (arbitrary precision, decimal string).

exact.description: scalar: present and true when the value is backed by an exact real rather than a rational.

value.description: boolean: the truth value; string: the text; symbol: the bare name.

reason.description: nil: the absence reason, or null for a bare literal NIL. The reason is the only absence datum the spine observes; origin/recoverability are diagnostic state, not wire fields.
